_comment: WO-1684 / HEART-011 — THE ONE AUTHORED TABLE FOR HEARTBOUND TELEMETRY BUCKETS.
WO-1684 acceptance 4: 'Amounts are bucketed, and the bucket edges live in config.'
Spec :1084: 'Do not put unnecessary wallet addresses into general analytics.' The
same reasoning applies to exact staked balances — an exact balance keyed by a named
player is a financial detail about that person, and NOT ONE of the spec's ten
questions (:1096-1100) needs it. Every one of them is distributional.
⚠ THE LADDER BELOW IS DELIBERATELY IDENTICAL TO api/heartbound/status.js:400-408
(bucketOf, read at source 2026-09-10). That endpoint shipped its own private copy
of this ladder before this module existed, and it is the LIVE emitter of
skr_verification_success / skr_verification_failed. Two ladders over one axis would
put two different bucket vocabularies in one column of one table, so every chart
would need to know which seam wrote the row — the duplicated-state failure
CLAUDE.md §2/§5/§8/§16 each carry a scar from.
⛔ THIS LANE DID NOT EDIT status.js (out of its brief's file list). The labels are
matched instead, and re-pointing status.js's bucketOf at stakeBucket() here is
named in WORK_ORDER_1684_....RESULT.md as the one follow-up that closes the copy.
⚠ ONE DIFFERENCE OF UNIT, STATED SO NOBODY 'FIXES' IT: status.js buckets a u128 in
CHAIN BASE UNITS and divides by SKR_BASE_UNITS itself; this module buckets WHOLE SKR
as a Number, because that is the unit heartbound-resonance.js works in
(isEligible(actualSkr), applyPulse(state, actualSkr)) and the unit the pulse loop
already holds by the time it emits. The LABELS are the same; the input unit is not.
⚠ INTERIM HOME, exactly like api/_lib/heartbound-resonance-config.json says of
itself: Q-CONFIG (owner-ruled 2026-09-10) puts backend-only Heartbound knobs on the
Command Center rail as serverOnly rows — teaching api/_lib/tunable-manifest.js that
marker is explicitly forbidden to this lane, so this file is the honest interim, and
it is ONE file so lifting it later is a data move.
Ships to Vercel: .vercelignore re-includes /api wholesale (the precedent this
folder's heartbound-resonance-config.json and dungeon-manifest.json already rely on).
Every number here is pinned by test/heartbound-telemetry.test.js.
Whole SKR. `belowMax` is EXCLUSIVE (skr < belowMax), walked in order; the first
row that matches wins, and `overflow` is everything above the last row. A null or
non-finite amount is `unknown` — never 0, which would be a claim nobody measured.
continuousPulseCount. At one pulse per UTC day (Q-CADENCE, MAX_PULSES_PER_UTC_DAY
= 1 in heartbound-pulse.js:104) these read as days: a week, a month, a quarter, and
beyond. Spec question 7 — 'does staking duration correlate with retention' — is a
join of this bucket against the existing session events, which is why the edges are
calendar-shaped rather than round numbers.
Milliseconds. Spec :1082 asks for 'RPC latency' and 'processing duration' as
properties; a bucket keeps the column groupable and stops a per-row millisecond
figure from being read as a benchmark it is not.
